messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - Asteria (enterprise, VPC) reporting sustained 5xx rate in region us-east-3. Auto-alerting threshold breached - page oncall.
kevin-sre: taking this. can someone confirm customer-visible errors? @leah-cs
leah-cs: customer ops confirmed 20% of Asteria API requests are returning 503s, primary region degraded. They've throttled some clients but want a failover plan.
kevin-sre: quick check - is dedicated pool 'asteria-dedicated-us-east3' still up but under pressure or partially unreachable?
ops-bot: healthcheck: pool=asteria-dedicated-us-east3 status=degraded nodes=6/12 cpu=89% net_err_rate=0.12
sam-platform: seeing high preemption spikes on those hosts, likely noisy neighbor impacting inference runtime locks.
matt-eng: oncall notes: warm spare pool 'asteria-warm-us-west2' exists with pre-warmed KV cache. we prepared a coldshift playbook last quarter.
kevin-sre: ok plan proposal (fast): 1) incrementally shift traffic to us-west-2 warm pool via traffic-manager canary 2) lower DNS TTL and prepare DNS cutover if canary healthy 3) keep dedicated pool isolated for postmortem. Agree? :thumbsup:
leah-cs: customer ops agrees to canary shift. will notify their SRE and put support page note.
customer-ops-asteria: confirming, we are ready for canary. set 10% first. we'll monitor error rates and latency.
kevin-sre: executing canary now. running redwoodctl command to steer tenant traffic.
kevin-sre: ```
# steer 10% -> us-west-2 warm pool
redwoodctl route update --tenant asteria --from-region us-east-3 --to-region us-west-2 --percent 10 --policy canary --dry-run=false
```
ops-bot: routing update accepted, change_id=chg-8401, started=3160001260
kevin-sre: canary live. metrics dashboards pinned in #incidents. monitoring latency, 5xx, and token loss.
laura-night: noted, I'm shadowing for now and will take lead for night shift if we need longer ops.
matt-eng: monitoring: 5xx dropped from 20% -> 6% within 90s for the canary subset. overall still ~12% until more traffic moves.
kevin-sre: proceed to 50% after 5 minutes if no regressions. continuing to watch request p95 and model fallbacks.
leah-cs: Asteria SRE confirms internal client retries decreased errors for canary traffic.
kevin-sre: bumping to 50% now.
kevin-sre: ```
redwoodctl route update --tenant asteria --to-region us-west-2 --percent 50 --policy canary --change-id chg-8401
```
ops-bot: routing update accepted, change_id=chg-8401-step2, started=3160001380
matt-eng: warm pool capacity report: us-west2 warm nodes=24/24 GPUs ready, prefix cache warmed=ok. latency delta +12ms median.
customer-ops-asteria: no regression on our side at 50%, fine to continue.
kevin-sre: prepare DNS cutover plan if we need permanent shift. current DNS TTL is 300s. recommend lower to 60s before cutover.
sam-platform: I can push TTL change via registrant. need approval from platform lead for registrar access.
leah-cs: approve TTL to 60s for Asteria apex. customer notified.
kevin-sre: executing TTL change and starting final shift to 100% if stable.
kevin-sre: ```
# lower TTL
registrar-cli change-ttl --zone asteria.example.com --record @ --ttl 60
# final route
redwoodctl route update --tenant asteria --to-region us-west-2 --percent 100 --policy immediate --change-id chg-8401-final
```
ops-bot: registrar change accepted, propagation_eta=60s
ops-bot: routing final update accepted, started=3160001530
matt-eng: watching model quality/regression checks. no increase in failure modes. latency stable.
kevin-sre: final traffic now at 100% in us-west-2. us-east-3 pool will be quarantined for forensic and we will cordon nodes.
sam-platform: cordoning now: `kubectl cordon pool/asteria-dedicated-us-east3` ; draining non-critical workloads.
ops-bot: cordon complete, drained replicas=18
leah-cs: informed customer that traffic moved and we've quarantined affected pool. provided their SRE with runbook for client-side metrics to expect.
customer-ops-asteria: thanks. we'll keep monitoring and will escalate if any lingering client errors.
kevin-sre: handing primary ops lead to laura-night for night watch and postmortem follow-up. I will stay on call until handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
laura-night: taking lead. noted actions: postmortem owners matt-eng + sam-platform, CS follow-up leah-cs, timeline capture in confluence.
kevin-sre: creating incident ticket and linking change IDs. incident-bot please create summary.
incident-bot: Created Incident INC-3160001 | Asteria regional coldshift -> us-west-2 | severity=SEV2 | owners=[laura-night, kevin-sre]
laura-night: will update the customer-facing incident timeline and keep this channel updated. closing active paging for oncall now. any outstanding asks?
matt-eng: preserve logs from affected hosts: `s3://redwood-logs/asteria/us-east-3/retain/3160001234` and snapshot disk images.
kevin-sre: great work team. follow-up: schedule postmortem in 48 hours and validate noisy neighbor mitigations for dedicated pool.
leah-cs: customer ops requests a retro and confirmation when noisy neighbor quota fixes are applied.
laura-night: noted, will include in postmortem action items. :spiral_notepad:
customer-ops-asteria: appreciate the quick shift. keep us posted.
kevin-sre: signing off from active lead, available if needed. :v:
laura-night: channel will remain pinned for updates. moving to monitoring phase."
